# Generate STS(15) blocks
points = []
for i in range(15):
    vec = tuple((i >> (3-j)) & 1 for j in range(4))
    points.append(vec)

point_to_idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(points)}

blocks_set = set()
for i in range(15):
    for j in range(i+1, 15):
        a = points[i]
        b = points[j]
        c = tuple((a[k] ^ b[k]) for k in range(4))
        if c == (0,0,0,0):
            continue
        block = tuple(sorted([point_to_idx[a], point_to_idx[b], point_to_idx[c]]))
        blocks_set.add(block)

blocks = sorted(blocks_set)

# Duplicate each block to get 70 blocks
all_blocks = blocks + blocks  # 70 blocks

# Build incidence matrix
v = 15
b = 70
x = [[0]*b for _ in range(v)]
for col_idx, block in enumerate(all_blocks):
    for row_idx in block:
        x[row_idx][col_idx] = 1

# Verify row sums
row_sums = [sum(row) for row in x]
print(f"Row sums: {row_sums}")

# Verify column sums
col_sums = [sum(x[i][j] for i in range(v)) for j in range(b)]
print(f"Column sums: min={min(col_sums)}, max={max(col_sums)}")

# Verify pairwise inner products
pair_products = {}
for i1 in range(v):
    for i2 in range(i1+1, v):
        prod = sum(x[i1][j] * x[i2][j] for j in range(b))
        pair_products[(i1,i2)] = prod

print(f"Pair products: min={min(pair_products.values())}, max={max(pair_products.values())}")

# Flatten to list
flat = [x[i][j] for i in range(v) for j in range(b)]
print(f"Length: {len(flat)}")
print(f"First few: {flat[:20]}")
